title: Cut Silence
description: See the waveform, pick the part you want, and auto-remove the silent parts — audio or video.
dropLabel: Drop your audio or video here or click to browse
dropHint: Videos come back as MP4 without the silent parts
previewUnavailable: Preview isn't available for this format, but processing still works.
dragHint: Drag the edges of the highlighted region to keep only that part. Press play to listen before processing.
sampleHint: For more precise cuts: select a moment with only background noise, then click "Mark as silence sample" — the cuts calibrate to your recording.

modeHint.off: No silence cutting — exports exactly the selected region.
modeHint.gentle: Cuts only pauses longer than 1 second — safest for natural speech.
modeHint.balanced: Cuts pauses over 0.6s, keeping a little breathing room. Good default.
modeHint.aggressive: Cuts almost every pause — tight, fast-paced result.

nothingToDo: Select a region or turn on silence cutting to process.
nothingToCut: No significant silences found in the selection — kept as is.
